LanguageData.ESCP_FlowerKings_Enlist_Letter_Title: In service to the Flower Kings
LanguageData.ESCP_FlowerKings_Enlist_Letter_Label: The colony now serves the Ayleid Flower Kings. They pay in coin and in welkynd light.

LanguageData.ESCP_FlowerKings_Enlist_Requrements_Not_: The Flower Kings see no worth in you yet. Standing: {0}.

LanguageData.ESCP_FlowerKings_Provisions_Desc: Food and herbs from the Ayleid cities.
LanguageData.ESCP_FlowerKings_Storage_Desc: Leave goods in an Ayleid vault.
LanguageData.ESCP_FlowerKings_Resign_Letter_Label: The colony has left the service of the Flower Kings.
LanguageData.ESCP_FlowerKings_Resign_Button_Desc: End your service to the Ayleid kings.
LanguageData.ESCP_FlowerKings_Kick_Out_Label_Title: The Flower Kings have no further use for the colony.
LanguageData.ESCP_FlowerKings_Work_0_Desc: Keep the light stones of an Ayleid city charged.
LanguageData.ESCP_FlowerKings_Work_1_Desc: Stand watch at an Ayleid city's gates.
